capabilities.input_domain: finite mono audio and attack, sustain, fast, and slow envelope controls
capabilities.output_domain: transient-shaped mono audio plus contrast and gain telemetry

capabilities.summary: Prepared intersample true-peak limiter with explicit lookahead and channel linking.

lifecycle.prepare: control; may allocate detector and delay storage

capabilities.state_model: Prepared intersample detector, scheduling horizon, lookahead delay, and gain state.
capabilities.input_domain: finite interleaved audio, ceiling, lookahead, release, and channel-link policy
capabilities.output_domain: true-peak-limited audio and gain-reduction telemetry
capabilities.latency: detector latency plus scheduling horizon plus user lookahead

capabilities.summary: Deterministic unison voice layout and PolyBLEP supersaw oscillator bank.
capabilities.state_model: Fixed deterministic layout parameters and bounded oscillator array.
capabilities.input_domain: note frequency, unison specification, seed, and absolute frame
capabilities.output_domain: stereo unison audio and per-child layout parameters

capabilities.summary: Prepared bidirectional waveguide rails, passive reflection boundaries, and fixed-capacity pressure-wave scattering junctions.

lifecycle.prepare: control; line preparation allocates bounded retained history

capabilities.state_model: Two prepared double-precision traveling-wave histories and a smoothed length, one-pole boundary state, and fixed-capacity impedance plus prior-output state.
capabilities.input_domain: finite traveling pressure waves, bounded fractional line lengths, passive reflection controls, and two to four positive impedance ratios
capabilities.output_domain: delayed, reflected, or losslessly scattered traveling pressure waves
capabilities.latency: current smoothed one-way line length (target reported separately); reflection and junction operations add zero samples, and two-phase boundary composition adds no hidden sample
capabilities.tail: prepared line history plus passive one-pole boundary decay until reset
capabilities.scheduling: sample-synchronous; feedback networks read every line output, compute all boundaries, then push every line input in the same frame

capabilities.summary: Reusable analysis-window generation and allocation-free in-place application.
capabilities.state_model: Stateless static utility; generate returns caller-owned allocated coefficients and apply mutates caller-owned samples without allocation.
capabilities.input_domain: window size, window family, optional Kaiser parameter, and samples
capabilities.output_domain: window coefficients or in-place windowed samples

capabilities.summary: Canonical persisted beat-division vocabulary with exact tick conversion.
capabilities.state_model: Pure enum, fraction, and tick-duration value conversion.
capabilities.input_domain: persisted beat-division ordinal
capabilities.output_domain: exact quarter-note fraction and document tick duration

capabilities.summary: Stateless seeded probability keyed by stable musical coordinates.
capabilities.state_model: Pure coordinate hash and exact integer-ratio predicate with no mutable RNG.
capabilities.seed_model: caller-supplied 64-bit seed plus tick, lane, cycle, and stream coordinates
capabilities.input_domain: seed, musical coordinate, and exact probability ratio
capabilities.output_domain: deterministic probability selection

capabilities.summary: Bounded projection of musical grid points through resolved transport ranges.
capabilities.state_model: Pure projection over caller-owned immutable compiled tempo and meter maps, resolved ranges, and fixed output storage.
capabilities.input_domain: resolved half-open transport ranges and beat division
capabilities.output_domain: bounded frame-offset grid events with timeline and monotonic coordinates

capabilities.summary: Fixed-capacity swing and groove projection that rejects event reordering.
capabilities.state_model: Immutable copied groove table with bounded validation and allocation-free lookup.
capabilities.input_domain: authored event ticks, rational swing, and fixed-capacity groove steps
capabilities.output_domain: order-preserving event ticks and velocity scale

capabilities.summary: Clock-locked bounded ratchet subdivision over half-open tick intervals.
capabilities.state_model: Pure fixed-capacity integer subdivision with caller-owned output storage.
capabilities.input_domain: clock interval, hit count, and half-open projection window
capabilities.output_domain: bounded tick-position ratchet onsets

capabilities.summary: Exact rational swing projection with bounded-rounding recovery over integer document ticks.
capabilities.state_model: Pure value and free-function transforms; unswing recovers within the documented rounding bound, and invalid inputs leave positions unchanged.
capabilities.input_domain: document ticks and rational swing
capabilities.output_domain: document ticks

capabilities.summary: Validated sample-rate-specific tempo compilation with deterministic, allocation-free tick and sample lookup.
capabilities.state_model: Immutable owned compiled segments produced by a validating control-thread factory; published lookup values are allocation-free.
capabilities.input_domain: authored tempo points, rational sample rate, ticks, and samples
capabilities.output_domain: integer sample positions and nearest canonical ticks with explicit sample error
capabilities.scheduling: pure coordinate conversion after control-thread compilation

capabilities.summary: Saturating integer musical position on the 705600-tick quarter-note grid.
capabilities.state_model: Value type with saturating arithmetic over signed 64-bit ticks.
capabilities.input_domain: document ticks
capabilities.output_domain: document ticks

capabilities.summary: Fixed-capacity authored trigger grid with block-invariant window projection.
capabilities.state_model: Inline fixed-capacity track-step cells; projection does not mutate the grid.
capabilities.seed_model: caller supplies one stable 64-bit probability word per configured coordinate
capabilities.input_domain: authored trigger cells, cycle origin, half-open tick window, and probability words
capabilities.output_domain: bounded step-major trigger events
